reviews.comment: Professor Dror is very well-informed. There are quizzes almost every week, starting in week 2 or 3. There is quite a bit to read, but I found the topics interesting. Definitely takes up a lot of time, but I enjoyed the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Dror is the type of professor you go to Texas A&M for. She has lived and studied all over the world and provides a ton of unique perspectives. You can tell she really cares about students and she is willing to work with students outside of class. If you don't do the readings or go to class do not expect to do well.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Dror was a very insightful lecturer and piqued my curiosity when it came to East Asian history. You're expected to read thoroughly and gain a deep understanding of the content, but as long as you demonstrate that you're involving yourself in the material, you'll be fine. The midterm and final are written essays in class. Ask questions!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Her teaching is alright but not good enough for how she grades. Quiz and exam grades feel arbitrary. If you don't meet her expectations she'll give you any grade. If you fail two quizzes and don't make them up, she'll dock off almost a letter grade. Her class feels like it's set up so she can give you any grade she wants whether it's fair or not

Dr. Dror is an incredibly kind professor. Do not let her syllabus fool you, the class work is very manageable and as long as you do the reading she assigns it's not hard to do well in her class. She is very knowledgeable and willing to help if you ask her.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Dror was easily one of the best Professors I have had so far here at TAMU. She is very knowledgeable, wise, and understanding, and she makes the course fun and interesting by encouraging class participation and discussion. Her course can be a challenge; however, as long as you read the readings and participate, you will be fine! Take her!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Dror is an exceptional professor with deep wisdom making learning engaging and meaningful. Having taken 2 of her classes, I can confidently say her teaching style is clear, thought-provoking, and accessible. Her quizzes are easy if you do the readings, and each assignment enriches you. She's kind, flexible, and invests in her students' growth.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: I have taken Dr. Dror for 3 classes in a row (A's in all). If you are expecting a blow off class, her class is not for you! There are quizzes over the readings. The questions aren't hard, but if you didn't do the reading you're SOL. She is flexible if you miss a quiz. A big portion of her class is in-class discussion. Be prepared to speak in class
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Dror is very straightforward with her expectations and policies. Despite her busy schedule, she is very accessible by email and office hours. She assigns lots of readings but they are all incredibly worth your time. I have learned a lot more through one class with her as I have with multiple classes with other professors.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Dror is a fair professor. When I took 350, there were a lot of books we read. It was a T/R class, and for most of the semester, Tuesday was a lecture day, Thursday was a quiz day over the readings, and a discussion. Quizes were easy if you did the readings. The class was engaging, and the discussion was insightful. 100% recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Dror is a fantastic professor. A lot of the classes are fully dedicated to student discussion and feedback which is one of the best aspects of the class. She will try to make your life easier and is very flexible if you miss a quiz or something and need to make it up. Reading is very important for participation and class is always fun.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Dror's classes are not difficult if you actually do the work in the syllabus. She does not grade hard unless you are wildly off the mark. She is probably the reason I am as good of a writer as I am today.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This lady is a joke, a&m brings in millions of dollars a year to hire people like her? There is no reason for someone to grade this hard. If your care about your mental health take someone else.

reviews.comment: Dr. Dror is a good professor and easy to work with when asking for help on assignments. Lectures did not matter as we were never tested on them, but attendance still mandatory. reviews.comment: If you value your time and mental well-being do not take this class. Attendance is mandatory, 4 page paper for any quiz grade below an 85. Cant read her handwriting and she grades ridiculously hard. Dont expect any help from her except for a "tough luck" attitude. Steer clear
reviews.ratingTags: So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: If you're having any sort of personal or mental problems, don't take this class. It takes up a majority of your time and is graded in the most ridiculous way I've ever seen. The amount of reading makes it seem like this prof expects this to be your only class that semester. Failing a quiz (<85) means a 4 page paper in your future. DONT TAKE!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I'm currently in History 352 and there's a lot to say. Her class is extremely time-consuming, but you will definitely learn a lot. Reading is required in order to pass the class, but the quizzes are very easy. You will be reading entire books weekly so plan ahead. Write your essays as if it were going to be read by a 5th grader.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I took her for two semesters. The first time, I got a C. But this past semester I go an A. She can be a tough grader but she just wants the best out of you. Her lectures are very unbiased as she tries to give you both perspectives. I learned so much from her classes. Also, read the books she assigns. You will be quizzed over them

reviews.comment: Not an easy class, but she'll help you get a good grade.
I meant to say she is very helpful!!

Taken my last semester, this is the only real/serious college class i feel like i've taken.  Dr. Dror is very passionate and knowledgeable and expects her students to read, participate, and have opinions.  Be prepared for a lot of reading and essay quizzes and exams.
